transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

...Just some issues at work, I guess. Things have been... complicated, ever since I got this county safety award. 

Um... certain people there have been twisting my inspection reports around. Asking these really pointed budget questions. It's... well, it feels like they're trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor just tells me it's a normal review process, but... I can tell there's a coordinated effort to discredit me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you think these people are actually plotting against you?

I mean... yeah. Like I just said. 

It's... it's a coordinated thing. They're twisting my reports and asking all those budget questions for a reason. They want to make me look crooked. My boss keeps telling me it's just a normal review, but... I know what I'm seeing. So... yeah. I do.
Have you experienced any other situations in your life where you felt like people were plotting against you?
No. ...Not really. Just this situation at work. I haven't had this kind of problem before.
Do you feel like you deserve special treatment or recognition because of your work or the award you received?

No. ...Not at all. 

I just... I just do my job. The award was fine, but I'm not asking for anything special. I just don't want my reports tampered with.
Do you think you're more important than others because of your work or the award you received?

No. I... I think I just answered that. 

I'm just a regular guy. I inspect the routes, I do my job... that's it. I don't think I'm better than anybody else.
Are you having these thoughts about people plotting against you outside of work as well?

No. ...Just at work. 

When I'm off the clock, I just go home and keep to myself. Everything is fine outside of work. It's... it's only the guys at the depot I have to watch out for.
Do you still think people at work are plotting against you when you're not thinking about work or the inspection reports?

No. ...If I'm not thinking about work, then I'm not thinking about them. 

I just... I leave it at the depot. Like I said, when I'm home, I just do my own thing.
Do you still believe people at work are plotting against you when you're thinking about it at home?

Yeah, I mean... if I'm thinking about work, then yeah, I'm thinking about what they're doing. 

It's just... it's about the job. If work is on my mind, then they are too. But I try not to bring it home if I can help it.
Are there any people outside of work that you think are plotting against you?
No. ...Like I said, it's just the depot. I don't really deal with anyone else, so... no.
How long have you been thinking that people at work are plotting against you?
It's been... about a year, I guess. Started right around the time I got recognized for the county safety initiative. Just... ever since then, really.
Do you often find yourself wondering if strangers might be talking about you or watching you?
No. I don't... I don't really pay attention to people I don't know.
Do you ever have moments where you doubt that people at work are actually plotting against you?

No. ...Not really. I mean, my supervisor tries to tell me it's just a normal review process. But... I know what I'm seeing. They twist my inspection reports. They ask all these pointed budget questions... trying to make me look crooked. It's... it's a coordinated effort to discredit me. Ever since that award. So... no. I don't doubt it.
Have you generally been a trusting person in your relationships before this situation at work started?
I guess so. Yeah. I mean... I've got a few close friends. Never really had a problem trusting them. Just... this is different. It's work.
Have you started to distrust your close friends since this situation at work began?
No. ...Not really. They don't work with me, so... there's no reason to.
Do you think your work or the award you received has changed how people perceive you in a significant way?
I don't know. Maybe. People get jealous, I guess. I just do my job. It's not my fault they gave me the award. But... yeah, I guess it changed things.
Have you ever thought that people outside of your work situation, such as friends or family members, might be plotting against you or trying to harm you in some way?
No. I just told you, they don't work with me. It's... it's just the guys at the yard. My family and friends are fine.
Do you think it's possible that you might be misinterpreting the actions of your coworkers?

I don't think so. I mean... I know what I'm seeing. Ever since I got that county safety award, things changed. They started... twisting my inspection reports. Asking all these pointed questions about the budget. Like they're trying to make me look crooked or something. My supervisor keeps telling me it's just a normal review process, but... I can tell. It's coordinated. They're trying to discredit me. So, no... I'm not misinterpreting anything.
Have you ever had any moments, no matter how brief, where you questioned or doubted the idea that your coworkers are plotting against you?

No. I... I just told you what's happening. Why would I doubt it? 

I see them twisting my inspection reports. I hear those pointed budget questions. My supervisor can say it's just a normal review all he wants, but... it's not. I know it's a coordinated effort to discredit me and make me look crooked. So... no. I don't question what I know is happening.
Are there any situations outside of work where you feel like people are treating you differently or unfairly since you received the county safety award?
No. Just at work. Like I said, it's just the guys at the yard. Everything else is... fine.
Have you generally been suspicious of other people's intentions or motives before this situation at work started?
No. Not really. Just... normal, I guess. It's just this thing at work.
